blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: syrupUSDC is a tracked strategy-vault variant whose parent USDC has confirmed centralized freeze exposure, so wrapper holders inherit upstream blacklistability.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Ethereum is the sole canonical syrupUSDC issuance route: the MaplePool ERC-4626 vault mints strategy-vault shares against USDC deposits and its CCIP LockReleaseTokenPool escrows remote circulation. Base, Arbitrum, Solana, Ink, Monad, Robinhood Chain, and Tempo are Chainlink CCIP CCT burn/mint bridge representations, even where Maple describes them as natively available; the destination token identities and pools are confirmed by Chainlink's live directory, while the previously reviewed destination controls and canonical-side MapleCCIPReceiver remain assessed here under Bridge Risk.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Pharos bridge-route re-verification; 2026-08-23 Chainlink directory coverage refresh

controls.label: Maple Ethereum MapleCCIPReceiver DEFAULT_ADMIN Safe

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The verified MapleCCIPReceiver UUPS implementation fixes the Ethereum CCIP Router at 0x80226fc0Ee2b096224EeAc085Bb9a8cba1146f7D; exact current chain-type and remote-peer configuration was not fully enumerated in this review.
routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: The canonical-side receiver admin can rescue tokens and withdraw funds from the bridge receiver.
routeChecks.caps: The receiver admin can set bridge fees and chain types and enable or disable deposits/redemptions; no independent native syrupUSDC issuance cap is attributed to this bridge receiver.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on MapleCCIPReceiver 0x02B6A75c5D1F430F0614dc5AC8aD5F9D35fbA2c4 is held by the 3-of-5 Safe and can change chain types and fees, enable/disable deposits/redemptions, rescue tokens, withdraw funds, and authorize UUPS upgrades to implementation 0x23CEF2965Db19f67A996371F9Cb1A2F33D2b4821.

controls.capDescription: The 3-of-5 Safe administers the canonical-side CCIP receiver and can change bridge fee/chain settings or replace its UUPS implementation; this is transfer-rail administration, not direct native MaplePool share issuance.
bypassSurfaces: The DEFAULT_ADMIN Safe can authorize UUPS upgrades to the MapleCCIPReceiver implementation.
The receiver can rescue tokens and withdraw funds; exact active remote-peer and route-limit state was not fully enumerated.
controls.evidence: Fresh Ethereum review identified MapleCCIPReceiver proxy 0x02B6A75c5D1F430F0614dc5AC8aD5F9D35fbA2c4 with verified UUPS implementation 0x23CEF2965Db19f67A996371F9Cb1A2F33D2b4821 and the fixed Ethereum CCIP Router 0x80226fc0Ee2b096224EeAc085Bb9a8cba1146f7D. RoleGranted logs identify DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE account 0xce1ce7c7f436dcc4e28bc8bf86115514d3dc34e8; the Safe is 3-of-5 with the five owners recorded above and no enabled module. The verified receiver source gives this admin chain-type, fee, deposit/redemption, rescue, withdrawal, and UUPS-upgrade powers.

routeChecks.caps: No aggregate or per-call mint ceiling was evidenced in the reviewed reads; representation capacity is governed by CCIP pool and rate-limit configuration.

controls.evidence: At Base block 50067565 on 2026-08-16, verified BurnMintERC20 behavior was observed for syrupUSDC and the Base BurnMintTokenPool 0xa36955b2bc12aee77ff7519482d16c7b86dbe42a held the token's current MINTER_ROLE and BURNER_ROLE.
